html:
The Kingdom of Asturias was a small Christian kingdom in the mountains of northern Spain, founded about 718. It is on the map for 800 and 900.

When the Umayyads conquered Hispania and the Visigothic Kingdom fell, a nobleman named Pelagius led a revolt in the Cantabrian mountains. His win at Covadonga around 718 to 722 is remembered as the start of the Reconquista. Alfonso II made Oviedo the capital, and in his reign a tomb in Galicia was declared to be that of Saint James, the beginning of the pilgrimage to Santiago de Compostela.

The kings slowly pushed south into the empty Duero valley against the Emirate of Córdoba. In the early 900s they moved their seat to León, and the kingdom became the Kingdom of León.
sum: The Kingdom of Asturias was a small Christian kingdom in the mountains of northern Spain, founded about 718. It is on the map for 800 and 900.
